title: FANO: Anchored Forward-Noise Optimization for Diffusion Inverse Problems
title_zh: FANO：面向扩散逆问题的锚定前向噪声优化

paragraphs.en: FANO通过锚定估计并仅优化前向噪声，保持扩散结构，改进扩散模型求解逆问题的性能。 Pre-trained diffusion models have become a widely adopted zero-shot prior for image inverse problems, among which annealed decoupling methods achieve leading reconstruction performance on nonlinear tasks. We find, however, that annealed methods that directly optimize the denoiser input $x_t$ exhibit radial drift in later layers: within-layer optimization drives the noise-component norm of $x_t$ away from its typical value, pushing the denoiser out of its high-performance regime and degrading reconstruction quality. To address this, we propose FANO (Anchored Forward-Noise Optimization). At each annealing layer, FANO fixes the previous denoiser estimate as an anchor and optimizes only the forward noise $e$, whose distribution is known, instead of $x_t$, thereby preserving the forward-diffusion structure of the denoiser input. The standard Gaussian prior on $e$ concentrates its norm near the typical value, and deviations degrade denoiser performance. We accordingly decompose $e$ in polar coordinates into a direction and a radial magnitude, and apply a soft potential to regulate the radius, keeping $x_t$ in the high-density region of the forward distribution. On multiple linear and nonlinear inverse problems, FANO matches the strongest current baselines on linear tasks and achieves consistent improvements on nonlinear tasks.
paragraphs.zh: FANO通过锚定估计并仅优化前向噪声，保持扩散结构，改进扩散模型求解逆问题的性能。预训练扩散模型已成为图像逆问题中广泛采用的零样本先验，其中退火解耦方法在非线性任务上取得了领先的重建性能。 然而，我们发现直接优化去噪器输入 $x_t$ 的退火方法在后续层会出现径向漂移：层内优化使 $x_t$ 的噪声分量范数偏离其典型值，将去噪器推出其高性能区间，从而降低重建质量。 为解决这一问题，我们提出FANO（锚定前向噪声优化）。 在每个退火层，FANO将上一次的去噪器估计固定为锚点，仅优化分布已知的前向噪声 $e$，而非 $x_t$，从而保持去噪器输入的前向扩散结构。 $e$ 上的标准高斯先验使其范数集中于典型值附近，偏差会降低去噪器的性能。 为此，我们将 $e$ 在极坐标下分解为方向和径向幅值，并施加软势来调节半径，使 $x_t$ 保持在前向分布的高密度区域。 在多个线性和非线性逆问题上，FANO在线性任务上与当前最强基线持平，并在非线性任务上取得一致的改进。
